name: IM-1 Odysseus
tagline: First U.S. lunar landing since Apollo; sideways
description: The first US lunar landing since Apollo 17 in 1972. Touched down sideways near the lunar south pole on 2024-02-22 (the primary laser rangefinder had been left inactive — safety switch not armed pre-launch); operated briefly before sunset.
best_known_for: First U.S. lunar landing since Apollo; sideways
